games.title: 团子的美食大冒险 3D
games.desc: 吃出健康的 3D 跑酷：绿泡健康食品要吃，红泡垃圾食品要躲。9 大地图轮换、无限连闯、连击倍率、1100 件装扮扭蛋、家园布置与美食图鉴。
games.descEn: Eat-healthy 3D runner: grab green bubbles, dodge red junk food. 9 maps, endless levels, combo multipliers, 1100-piece gacha wardrobe, home decor and a food codex.
games.controls: ←→ / A D 移动 · 空格 / W 跳跃 · Esc 暂停 · 触屏：左右半屏移动，右下角跳
games.controlsEn: ←→ / A D move · Space / W jump · Esc pause · Touch: tap the left / right half to move, bottom-right corner to jump

games.title: 团子卡丁车 3D
games.desc: 8 车竞速的 3D 卡丁车：3 条主题赛道、9 位动物车手、跑跑卡丁车式漂移蓄氮气、问号箱道具、车库图鉴与抽奖，HUD 带小地图与最佳单圈。
games.descEn: 8-kart 3D racer: 3 themed tracks, 9 animal drivers, drift-to-charge nitro, item boxes, garage, codex and gacha. Full racing HUD with minimap and best lap.
games.controls: W 油门 · S 刹车 · A D / ←→ 转向 · Shift 漂移蓄氮 · 空格 放氮气 · E 道具 · Esc 暂停
games.controlsEn: W throttle · S brake · A D / ←→ steer · Shift drift to charge nitro · Space boost · E use item · Esc pause

games.title: 团子的森林大冒险 3D
games.desc: 系列的起点：9 关 × 3 大群系的 3D 跑酷躲避，10 种障碍与怪物，三档难度，金币换装衣橱。赛璐璐渲染 + Bloom 后处理，程序化天空与粒子，全部无外部资源。
games.descEn: Where the series began: 9 levels across 3 biomes, 10 obstacle types, 3 difficulties and a coin-powered wardrobe. Cel-shaded with bloom, fully procedural.
games.controls: ←→ / A D 移动 · 空格 / W 跳跃（可变跳高）· Esc 暂停 · 触屏：左右半屏移动，右下角跳
games.controlsEn: ←→ / A D move · Space / W jump (hold for height) · Esc pause · Touch: tap the left / right half to move, bottom-right corner to jump

games.title: 团子俄罗斯方块
games.desc: 糖果画风、现代标准手感的俄罗斯方块：7-bag 随机、SRS 旋转踢墙、锁延迟、Hold 暂存、影子预览、T-Spin、Back-to-Back 与 Combo 计分，DAS/ARR 跟手。
games.descEn: Candy-styled Tetris with modern guideline feel: 7-bag, SRS kicks, lock delay, hold, ghost piece, T-Spin, back-to-back and combo scoring, tuned DAS/ARR.
games.controls: ←→ 移动 · ↓ 软降 · 空格 硬降 · ↑ / X 顺旋 · Z 逆旋 · C / Shift 暂存 · P / Esc 暂停 · 触屏滑动与点击
games.controlsEn: ←→ move · ↓ soft drop · Space hard drop · ↑ / X rotate CW · Z rotate CCW · C / Shift hold · P / Esc pause · Touch: swipe and tap

games.title: 水果消消乐
games.desc: 手绘六种水果的三消：4 连出消除条、L/T 形出炸弹、5 连出彩虹球，特殊块连环引爆，掉落连锁 Combo 倍率递增。8 个关卡，星级评定，死局自动洗牌。
games.descEn: Hand-drawn match-3 with six fruits: line clears, bombs and rainbow balls that chain-detonate, cascade combos, 8 levels with star ratings and auto-reshuffle.
games.controls: 点击相邻两个水果交换，或按住拖动 · 三个以上连成一线即消除
games.controlsEn: Tap two adjacent fruits to swap, or drag · line up three or more to clear

games.desc: 经典数字合成：滑动把相同数字撞在一起，合出 2048。带滑动动画、10 步撤销、自动续档，合出 2048 后可继续冲更大的数。
games.descEn: Classic sliding merge puzzle with smooth animations, 10-step undo and auto-resume.
games.controls: ← ↑ → ↓ / W A S D 滑动 · 触屏划动 · Z 撤销 · R 新局
games.controlsEn: ← ↑ → ↓ / W A S D slide · swipe on touch · Z undo · R new game

games.title: 贪吃蛇
games.desc: 吃果子变长、别撞墙别咬自己。20×20 棋盘，每 5 个果子提速一档，限时金果值 5 倍分，格间平滑插值移动。
games.descEn: Classic snake on a 20×20 board: speed steps every 5 fruits, timed golden fruit worth 5×, smooth interpolated motion.
games.controls: 方向键 / W A S D 转向 · 触屏划动 · Esc / P 暂停 · R 重开
games.controlsEn: Arrow keys / W A S D turn · swipe on touch · Esc / P pause · R restart

games.title: 扫雷
games.desc: 初级 / 中级 / 高级三档，首击必安全，右键或长按插旗，点数字连锁翻开，手机有插旗模式开关，计时并记录各难度最佳。
games.descEn: Three difficulties, safe first click, flag by right-click or long-press, chording on numbers, a flag-mode toggle for touch, best times per level.
games.controls: 左键翻开 · 右键 / 长按插旗 · 点数字连锁翻开 · F 切换插旗模式 · R 新局
games.controlsEn: Left-click to reveal · right-click / long-press to flag · click a number to chord · F toggle flag mode · R new game

games.title: 打砖块
games.desc: 拖动挡板接球清砖，关卡图案轮换、双血砖块，道具掉落：加宽、分裂三球、减速、加命。击球角度随落点变化，连击加分。
games.descEn: Paddle-and-ball brick breaker: rotating level patterns, 2-hit bricks, drops for wide paddle, multi-ball, slow-mo and extra life.
games.controls: 鼠标 / 触屏拖动挡板 · ← → 移动 · 空格 / 点击发球 · Esc 暂停
games.controlsEn: Mouse / touch drag the paddle · ← → move · Space / tap to launch · Esc pause

games.title: 笨鸟先飞
games.desc: 点一下飞一下，穿过水管缝隙。缝隙随分数收窄、速度渐快，每 10 分昼夜交替，得分有铜银金奖牌。
games.descEn: Tap to flap through the pipes. Gaps narrow and speed rises with score, day/night swaps every 10 points, medals at 10/20/40.
games.controls: 点击 / 触屏 / 空格 / ↑ 飞 · R 重开
games.controlsEn: Click / tap / Space / ↑ to flap · R restart

games.title: 记忆翻牌
games.desc: 翻开两张一样的图案。15 种程序绘制的图标，4×3 / 4×4 / 6×5 三种规模，翻牌动画、步数与用时，记录各规模最少步数。
games.descEn: Flip two cards to find pairs. 15 procedurally drawn icons, three board sizes, flip animation, moves and timer, best-moves per size.
games.controls: 点击翻牌 · 一次翻两张 · R 重新洗牌
games.controlsEn: Tap to flip · two cards per turn · R reshuffle

games.title: 五子棋
games.desc: 15 路棋盘，人机（可选执黑或执白）或本地双人。电脑按活三活四等棋形攻防评估，落子预览、悔棋、胜线高亮。
games.descEn: 15×15 Gomoku vs a pattern-scoring AI (play black or white) or local two-player, with ghost preview, undo and winning-line highlight.
games.controls: 鼠标移到交叉点点击落子 · 触屏点一下预览再点确认 · Z 悔棋 · R 重开
games.controlsEn: Click an intersection to place a stone · on touch, tap to preview then tap again to confirm · Z undo · R restart

games.title: 数独
games.desc: 每题都是唯一解：先生成完整解再按唯一性挖空，简单 / 中等 / 困难。笔记模式、错误标红、同数高亮、提示，自动续档，记录各难度最佳用时。
games.descEn: Every puzzle has a unique solution. Three difficulties, pencil notes, error marking, same-digit highlight, hints, auto-resume, best times.
games.controls: 点格子选中 → 按数字填入 · 方向键移动 · N 笔记 · 0 / 退格清除 · H 提示
games.controlsEn: Tap a cell, then press a digit · arrow keys move · N notes · 0 / Backspace clear · H hint

games.title: 消灭星星
games.desc: 点相邻同色的星星整组消除，分数 = n²×5，一次消得越多越划算。列内下落、空列左移，每关目标递增，剩星少于 10 颗有额外奖励。
games.descEn: Pop groups of adjacent same-color stars; score = n²×5. Gravity and column collapse, rising level targets, bonus for clearing under 10 stars.
games.controls: 点一下选中一组 · 再点一下消除 · R 重开
games.controlsEn: Tap to select a group · tap again to pop it · R restart

games.title: 打地鼠
games.desc: 45 秒内敲掉尽可能多的地鼠：普通 +10、金鼠 +30、炸弹 −20 并清空连击。出现频率随时间加快，连击越高加分越多。
games.descEn: Whack as many moles as you can in 45 seconds: gold moles +30, bombs −20 and reset the combo. Spawns accelerate over time.
games.controls: 点击 / 触屏敲击 · 空格 / R 重开
games.controlsEn: Click / tap to whack · Space / R restart

games.title: 数字华容道
games.desc: 把打乱的数字滑回顺序。3×3 / 4×4 / 5×5，打乱方式保证一定可解，可一次推动整排，归位的方块颜色变亮，记录各规模最少步数。
games.descEn: Sliding number puzzle in 3×3, 4×4 and 5×5. Shuffles are always solvable, whole rows slide at once, best-moves per size.
games.controls: 点击与空格同行 / 同列的方块滑动 · 方向键推动 · R 重新打乱
games.controlsEn: Click a tile in the same row / column as the gap to slide · arrow keys push · R reshuffle
